notes: בֶּן of בֶּן־בָּקָר is unrepresented and the relational *of the herd* goes to the rectum under rule 19; fusing בֶּן־בָּקָר as one unit was the competing reading, defeated because the ASV spends *herd* on בָּקָר in particular, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet and rule 2 splits it.
The ethical dative לְ is unrepresented under rule 40 and its suffix takes *thee*, the ASV writing *Take thee* with a bare indirect object.
*them* after *offer* is `added` under rule 44: הַקְרֵב carries no object suffix, and a supplied object does not join the verb merely by standing beside its rendering.
תָּמִים → *without blemish* heads on *blemish* under rules 24 and 31, *without* being what English spends on the privative relation.
